ios.desc:
Photo backup, full restore, and transfer for iPhone, iPad, and Mac

BackiGo helps you back up photos, videos, iCloud Drive files, and contacts - then browse, restore, and move them whenever you need.

Unlike iCloud, which mainly syncs your data, and other backup apps that only store it, BackiGo creates real, restorable backups in original quality that you can browse, restore, and move across devices anytime.

Why BackiGo
• Back up iCloud Photos in original quality
• Save iCloud Shared Albums
• Create versioned backups of iCloud Drive
• Back up and export iCloud Contacts
• Back up local albums, Live Photos, and ProRAW
• Browse backups without restoring
• Restore to original or specific albums
• Transfer photos and videos across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, and more
• Back up to USB drives, NAS, or your own cloud storage
• Optional backup encryption for extra security
• Smart incremental and scheduled backups
• Secure web access with PIN and trusted devices
• No account required and no tracking

BackiGo Pro
• Unlimited backup and restore
• iCloud Photos, Drive, Contacts, and Shared Albums
• Backup encryption
• Scheduled automation
• One subscription for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Family Sharing for up to five members

Free trial included - back up to 500 photos and videos.
